Glisk click demo

A local report with two mouse targets. A left-click on the link jumps to the disclosure section; a left-click on its summary opens the body below.

Jump to the disclosure section

Two mouse targets

The green link above is a same-document fragment link; the pager moves the reading position and reports jumped.

The summary in the target section is a native disclosure control; a click opens its body and reports evidence expanded.

Disclosure section

Evidence: the click opened this body

The pager received an SGR left-press, focused the summary, and opened the disclosure. The status row names the toggle.

This paragraph was hidden before the click. It is ordinary document text: searchable, plain-text extractable, and reload-safe through the stable evidence id.

Reading continues

The fragment jump only moved the reading position. Scrolling, search, and focus still work, and the disclosure state survives a reload through its stable id.

Scrolling

Wheel reports and j/k move the same viewport; the status row shows the percentage.

Search

Search reveals matches even inside a closed disclosure, then n walks them.

Reload

Saving this file keeps the open disclosure and the reading position through stable ids.
